title: Client Discovery Harness - SWOT Issue
description: A compressed conclusion, never a starting point. finding_ids has minItems 1 so that the schema itself rejects a SWOT item produced by asking a model to 'write a SWOT'. This holds the classification only: the key issue and its strategic implication are a separate KeyIssue record, because a real issue usually arises from several SWOT items at once.

finding_ids.description: The findings this item compresses. Must not be empty.
